content: Firman Ardiansyah; C3 1120 856; 2015; Program Studi Produksi Ternak, Jurusan Peternakan Politeknik Negeri Jember. Komisi pembimbing, Ketua: Erfan Kustiawan S. Pt, MP Anggota: Ir.Achmad Marzuki, MP Kegiatan wirausaha ini bertujuan untuk mengoptimalkan efisiensi pakan sekaligus mendongkrak keuntungan pada usaha penggemukan domba lewat pemanfaatan pakan tebon jagung fermentasi. Lokasi kegiatan bertempat di kandang domba milik Bapak Zayadi di Desa Bajulmati, Kecamatan Wongsorejo, Kabupaten Banyuwangi dari tanggal 13 September 2015 hingga 7 November 2015, memakai 4 ekor bakalan domba berumur ± 8 bulan dengan bobot ±10 Kg. Pengolahan fermentasi tebon jagung menerapkan metode anaerob selama 7 hari memanfaatkan starter mikroba EM4. Pemberian pakan harian domba dihitung atas dasar bahan kering menggunakan perbandingan tebon jagung fermentasi.
label: ai

content: Hasil dari wirausaha penggemukan domba berbasis tebon jagung fermentasi selama masa pemeliharaan 2 bulan mencatatkan rata-rata konsumsi pakan segar 816,25 gram/ekor/hari, kenaikan bobot badan 109,32 gram/ekor/hari, serta analisis finansial: R/C Ratio 1,057, BEP produksi 61,38 Kg, BEP harga Rp 37.878/kg, dan perolehan laba Rp 141.305. Penerapan tebon jagung fermentasi dalam adonan pakan sangat potensial diimplementasikan demi mendongkrak produktivitas ternak dan efisiensi pakan sehingga dapat meraup laba usaha secara optimal.
label: ai

content: Para peternak di Pulau Jawa umumnya lebih memilih membudidayakan domba dan kambing karena karakteristiknya yang menguntungkan serta kebutuhan modal awal yang jauh lebih terjangkau dibandingkan ternak sapi, di samping laju reproduksi domba yang lebih cepat serta kemampuannya mengolah bahan pakan berkualitas rendah menjadi asupan bernutrisi tinggi, plus daya adaptasi domba yang sangat baik di beraneka kondisi lingkungan termasuk yang kurang mendukung. Domba tergolong sebagai ternak ruminansia kecil yang sudah amat akrab di kalangan masyarakat Indonesia. Domba memegang peran vital sebagai salah satu penyuplai komoditas daging (Harianto, 2010). Domba ekor gemuk memiliki karakteristik berupa ekor yang panjang dengan pangkal tebal dan lebar, tidak bertanduk, mampu beradaptasi baik di iklim tropis, serta ukuran tubuh yang lebih bongsor ketimbang domba lokal. Pakan domba secara umum terbagi dalam dua kelompok, yakni pakan hijauan dan pakan konsentrat. Pakan hijauan merupakan pakan pokok bagi ternak ruminansia, sehingga upaya peningkatkan produksi ternak wajib diimbangi dengan penyediaan hijauan yang berkualitas dan mencukupi, di tengah makin menyusutnya ketersediaan lahan pangan maupun industri. Di sisi lain, potensi alam berupa area padang penggembalaan di Indonesia tercatat mengalami penurunan hingga berkisar 30%. Solusi untuk mengatasi kelangkaan pakan hijauan ini adalah dengan memanfaatkan limbah hasil pertanian, salah satunya sisa tanaman jagung (Anonim, 2004).
label: ai

content: Beberapa di antaranya adalah tebon jagung, jerami jagung, klobot jagung, tongkol jagung, hingga tumpi, di mana tebon jagung menjadi opsi yang paling kerap dimanfaatkan sebagai pakan domba lantaran ketersediaannya yang mudah didapat (Umiyasih dan Wina, 2008).
label: ai

content: Tebon jagung mencakup seluruh bagian tanaman jagung di luar akarnya yang umumnya dipanen sewaktu tanaman memasuki usia 45 hari. Akan tetapi, tebon jagung mengandung serat kasar yang tinggi sehingga mampu menurunkan tingkat kecernaan pada domba, sehingga demi mengatasi hambatan tersebut, diperlukan teknik pengolahan pakan yang sanggup mereduksi kadar serat kasar, salah satunya melalui metode fermentasi. Menurut Umiyasih dan Wina (2008), proses fermentasi ditujukan untuk menekan serat kasar sekaligus mendongkrak kadar protein tebon yang berguna sebagai pakan domba agar mampu menghasilkan pertambahan bobot harian yang lebih tinggi ketimbang metode konvensional peternak yang hanya mengandalkan rumput lapangan, apalagi tebon jagung memiliki kandungan protein yang hampir setara dengan jenis hijauan lainnya. Oleh sebab itu, penggunaan pakan tebon jagung fermentasi sangat dianjurkan dalam program penggemukan domba. Langkah-langkahnya menurut Umiyasih dan Wina (2008) yaitu merajang tebon jagung menggunakan mesin pencacah atau alat pemotong manual. Formulasi adonannya terdiri dari tebon jagung (70%) yang dicampur molase (5%), dedak halus (15%), garam (0,5%), urea (0,5%), air (4%), serta EM4 (5%), kemudian disimpan rapat dalam wadah tertutup selama 7 hari.
label: ai

content: Proses fermentasi pada umumnya mampu mendongkrak kandungan gizi serta tingkat kecernaan bahan kering dari suatu bahan pakan, di samping menjadikan cita rasanya lebih disukai ternak. Tebon jagung sendiri merupakan tanaman dengan kadar protein yang lumayan tinggi, namun di sisi lain juga mengandungi serat kasar yang cukup tinggi, maka dari itu diperlukan proses fermentasi untuk mengikis kandungan serat kasar tersebut, sekaligus mengoptimalkan kandungan nutrisi dan daya cernanya, sehingga diharapkan mampu memacu laju pertumbuhan domba serta menjadikan bisnis penggemukan domba lebih menguntungkan.
label: ai

content: Diabetes is classified as one of the oldest diseases on earth. This health condition is closely related to the metabolic process of glucose levels in the bloodstream. In the medical realm, the definition of diabetes mellitus encompasses a set of characteristic symptoms that appear due to a surge in blood sugar levels (hyperglycemia) because the body lacks the hormone insulin (Badawi, 2009). Based on data records from the WHO (World Health Organization), Indonesia ranks fourth globally for the number of people with diabetes mellitus. This study aims to identify the Relationship between Diet and Physical Activity in Outpatient Type II Diabetes Mellitus Patients at Kalisat Regional Hospital and Kaliwates General Hospital Jember. The applied method is an analytical survey with a cross-sectional design, where observation and data collection for both independent and dependent variables were conducted simultaneously at RSD Kalisat and RSU Kaliwates Jember. The final results of this study show no significant difference in diet, with a ρ (rho) value of 0.989 for urban respondents and a sig value of 0.662 for rural respondents, indicating no relationship. Diet at RSD Kalisat and RSU Kaliwates showed no meaningful difference because the majority of patients had a similar eating frequency, which is more than three times a day. Conversely, there was a significant difference in physical activity between RSD Kalisat and RSU Kaliwates patients, as indicated by a ρ (rho) value of 0.063 for urban respondents and 0.017 for rural respondents. Keywords: Diet, Physical Activity, and Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus.

content: Development of a Web-Based Measles Surveillance Reporting Information System Utilizing the FAST Methodology at the Jember District Health Office in 2016, authored by Winda Wardani Amalia (NIM G41120505), Medical Record Study Program, State Polytechnic of Jember, supervised by dr. Rinda Nurul K., M.Kes. and dr. Novita Nuraini, M.A.R.S., addresses measles as a highly infectious viral illness. Within Jember, measles ranks eighth among the top ten most prevalent diseases. Recorded incidences in Jember reached 112 cases in 2014 and 109 cases in 2015. Currently, the measles surveillance reporting mechanism in Jember lacks both effectiveness and efficiency. Sustaining efforts to eradicate and lower measles transmission requires a dedicated disease surveillance framework. Designing a web-based information system is essential to resolve existing operational bottlenecks through modern information technology. This study aims to architect an effective and efficient website-based measles surveillance reporting platform for the Jember District Health Office. The investigation employs a qualitative approach, gathering data via direct observation, interviews, Focus Group Discussions, and document analysis.
label: ai

content: The system architecture was formulated using the FAST framework. Findings indicate that the primary issue within the Jember Health Office's measles surveillance reporting lies in its continued reliance on semi-manual procedures. Specifically, reporting mandates capturing patient identities, incident dates, and immunization histories. To resolve this, a website-based measles surveillance reporting information system was proposed. System modeling incorporated flowcharts, Data Flow Diagrams (DFD), and Entity Relationship Diagrams (ERD). The platform was developed utilizing Dreamweaver alongside PHP and MySQL technologies.
label: ai

content: System construction was followed by validation using black-box testing methodologies. Personnel at the Jember District Health Department are recommended to adopt this web-based platform to accelerate data acquisition and enable prompt responses to measles outbreaks, particularly concerning field-level incidents.

content: Puskesmas Sumber Wringin remains less than optimal when handling patient registration due to its reliance on a manual system. Consequently, patient congestion frequently occurs in the waiting area because of slow processing at the registration desk. The objective of this study is to build an outpatient registration software at Sumber Wringin Public Health Center utilizing the waterfall approach which encompasses Requirement and Design, Encoding, and Testing. This system grants restricted access to the admin who oversees the registration responsibilities. The application capabilities encompass patient registration, patient record storage, patient data search, along with generating patient visit reports on a daily, monthly, and yearly basis, while incorporating automated audio announcements for polycall notifications.

content: Effect of Mixed Ethanol and Gasoline on 4 Step Torque and Mustofa Abdul Latif Study Program Renewable Energy Engineering Motorcycles represent a primary mode of transportation widely utilized across various layers of society, where automotive advancements among riders continue to accelerate rapidly over time, yet this progress remains mismatched regarding sustainable fuel consumption. To address the dwindling petroleum reserves and mounting air pollution, combining bioethanol with conventional fossil fuels serves as a viable technical solution; this study evaluates the mixing of bioethanol and pertamax to measure its direct influence on torque output and overall engine power performance across 4-stroke motorbikes. The tested fuel blend proportions consist of pure pertamax, a 10% bioethanol to 90% pertamax ratio, an 80:20 pertamax to bioethanol ratio, and a 70:30 pertamax to bioethanol mixture ratio. Using pure pertamax without bioethanol additives yielded a baseline torque reading of 25.70 N.m and produced 22.41 h.p of total engine output, whereas implementing the 10% bioethanol and 90% pertamax mixture produced revised operational figures.

content: Effects of CVT (Continuously Variable Transmission) Roller Weight Variations on the Performance of a 2010 Yamaha Mio Soul Motorcycle. Ahmad Robiul Awal Udin, ST, MT. (Primary Advisor) and Ir. DWI. Joko Suranto, MT (Co-Advisor) Kukuh Muhammad Eko Atmojo Pujo A Automotive Engineering Study Program Department of Mechanical Engineering This study was motivated by the researcher's observations in the motorcycle modification community. These modification efforts aim to achieve engine performance that exceeds standard capabilities. One common approach is varying the CVT roller mass to obtain the desired power or torque output. The objectives of this study were (1) To determine the effect of CVT roller weight on the performance of the Yamaha Mio Soul motorcycle.
label: ai

content: (2) To analyze the graphical patterns resulting from the interaction between CVT roller weight and Yamaha Mio Soul performance. (3) To identify the interaction effects of CVT roller weight on the motorcycle's overall output. An experimental method was employed in this research. The experiment was conducted to evaluate how varying roller weights impact the performance of the Yamaha Mio Soul automatic scooter. The findings revealed that (1) Varying the CVT roller mass did not show a statistically significant difference in torque and power when comparing standard and modified roller weights across wheel speeds. (2) Wheel speed variations had a significant impact on torque and power performance across different roller masses. (3) A maximum power output of 8.5 Hp was achieved using an 11-gram CVT roller within an engine speed range of 2000 rpm to 8000 rpm, while a peak torque of 12.87 Nm was recorded using the same 11-gram roller weight across the 2000 rpm to 8000 rpm engine speed range.

One effective technique involves altering the CVT roller mass to reach desired power or torque thresholds. The objective of this study is to. (2) Analyze the graphical trends generated from the relationship between CVT roller weight and Yamaha Mio Soul engine output. (3) Evaluate the overall interaction of CVT roller weight on Yamaha Mio Soul performance metrics. An experimental design was selected for this study. The experiment was executed to determine the influence of various roller weights on the dynamic performance of the Yamaha Mio Soul automatic scooter. The testing revealed that (1) There was no statistically significant impact on torque and power when comparing standard CVT roller mass with modified setups across engine speeds. (2) Engine speed variations produced a significant difference in both torque and power output across different CVT roller masses. (3) A maximum power output of 8.5 hp was registered using an 11-gram CVT roller within an engine speed band of 2000 rpm to 8000 rpm, whereas peak torque reached 12.87 Nm with the 11-gram CVT roller within the same 2000 rpm to 8000 rpm range.

content: To fulfill evolving human demands in an increasingly global era, targeted innovations are essential. Over the past two years, rapid technological advances have swept through the modern world. This trend is marked by the introduction of various novel technologies designed to support daily human activities, particularly within the automotive sector. In motorized vehicles, one notable breakthrough is evident in the adoption of Continuously Variable Transmission (CVT) systems, commonly found in automatic scooters. Customization efforts are predominantly intended to elevate engine performance above factory standard levels. Tuners utilize various strategies, one of which involves adjusting the CVT roller weight to achieve preferred power and torque outputs (Achmad 2013).

content: The automatic transmission system utilizing a CVT (Continuously Variable Transmission) setup consists of a primary driver pulley and a secondary driven pulley connected via a V-belt. Inside the primary driver pulley, a speed governor operates to alter the working diameter of the primary pulley. This speed governor houses six centrifugal rollers that experience centrifugal force as the crankshaft rotates, causing the rollers to slide outward and press the moveable pulley face (sliding sheave) toward the fixed pulley face (fixed sheave), which ultimately changes the primary pulley diameter. This alteration directly impacts the effective gear ratio (Atmika, 2015). According to Wibowo (2012), common issues in automatic motorcycles stem from how power transmission relates to system operations. Automatic motorcycles rely on CVT mechanisms to execute automatic transmission performance.

content: Factors Behind Incomplete Coding in Inpatient Medical Records at Kalisat Regional Hospital, Jember dr. Novita Nuraini, M.A.R.S (Advisor 1) Nabiilah Qurrota A’yun Health Information Management Study Program Medical record coding entries for inpatient care at Kalisat Regional General Hospital, Jember Regency, remain incomplete. During 2019's first quarter, nearly 20% of medical files lacked complete entries, violating Ministry of Health Decree No. 129/2008 which mandates a 100% completion rate for patient health records. Unfinished record documentation negatively impacts subsequent clinical operations, particularly the diagnostic coding workflow. This research aims to examine the root causes of incomplete inpatient record entries by applying Lawrence Green's behavioral model framework. A qualitative design was utilized for this study. Data collection involved structured interviews, direct field observations, document reviews, and administrative questionnaires. Findings reveal suboptimal staff knowledge and attitudes, a less supportive workspace environment, despite established SOPs governing record completion. Proposed remedies include delegating staff to professional training workshops, upgrading office layouts and equipment, along with re-socializing SOPs regarding inpatient medical record completeness.

content: Dampak negatif dari ketidaklengkapan atau ketiadaan kode diagnosis yakni nilai klaim biaya pelayanan kesehatan yang terhitung terlalu rendah dapat merugikan kas rumah sakit, sedangkan klaim yang terlalu tinggi bakal memberatkan pihak pasien. Begitu pula sebaliknya, ketika tarif pelayanan terhitung terlalu tinggi, rumah sakit seolah diuntungkan oleh selisih tersebut sehingga merugikan pihak penjamin (BPJS/asuransi) serta pasien, ditambah lagi ketidaklengkapan pengkodean ini turut merusak standar mutu dokumen rekam medis secara keseluruhan. Solusi terbaik guna mengatasi persoalan tersebut ialah dengan mengidentifikasi bermacam faktor pemicu yang menyebabkan tidak lengkapnya pengisian kode pada berkas medis.
label: ai

content: Berdasarkan pengamatan awal di Rumah Sakit Daerah Kalisat Jember, aspek-aspek pemicu ketidaklengkapan pengkodean ini dapat dianalisis menggunakan teori Lawrence Green mengenai perilaku manusia. Teori Lawrence Green memaparkan bahwa terdapat tiga pilar utama, yakni faktor predisposisi yang mencakup pemahaman, sikap, kepercayaan, keyakinan serta nilai-nilai pribadi, lalu faktor pendukung berupa fasilitas unit rekam medis termasuk kenyataan tata ruang kerja, serta faktor pendorong berupa petunjuk teknis seperti SOP (Standard Operating Procedure) rumah sakit maupun interaksi antar-rekan kerja. Berangkat dari krusialnya isu ini yang berdampak langsung pada klaim finansial, peneliti terdorong untuk melangsungkan riset bertajuk “Faktor Penyebab Ketidaklengkapan Kode Pada Berkas Rekam Medis Rawat Inap di RSD Kalisat Kabupaten Jember”.

content: Berdasarkan temuan dari studi awal, rumusan masalah dalam riset ini difokuskan untuk menganalisis pelbagai faktor yang mengakibatkan ketidaklengkapan kode diagnosis pada berkas rekam medis Rawat Inap di RSD Kalisat Kabupaten Jember.

content: Mengenali beragam faktor pemicu yang menyebabkan terjadinya ketidaklengkapan pengisian kode pada berkas rekam medis Rawat Inap di RSD Kalisat Kabupaten Jember.
label: ai

content: a. Mengkaji faktor predisposisi (pemahaman serta sikap mental petugas di unit rekam medis RSD Kalisat Jember) yang berkaitan dengan ketidaklengkapan kode diagnosis.

content: b. Mengkaji faktor pendukung (kelengkapan sarana prasarana serta kondisi lingkungan fisik unit rekam medis RSD Kalisat Jember) terkait ketidaklengkapan kode. c. Mengkaji faktor pendorong (Standard Operational Procedure) yang berhubungan dengan ketidaklengkapan kode diagnosis.
